groups.defect: Google update and delete fallbacks search for an absent externalCalendarId instead of selecting an available destination, losing the update calendar ID and directing deletion to primary.
groups.rationale: Both report the same broken fallback in both update and delete. The merged comment must retain both locations because each needs correction.

groups.defect: Office365 creation selects the first host's destination instead of the current credential's destination, causing failed or misdirected creation and mismatched saved references; Lark and the base calendar service repeat this selection mistake.
groups.rationale: All six report the same Office365 destination-selection defect; reference mismatches are consequences of that defect. s_d2d1c6a5 additionally reports the mistake in Lark and the base service, which must survive in the merged comment.

groups.defect: The Google Meet fallback dereferences an undefined first destination when destinationCalendar is null or empty, throwing instead of falling back to Cal Video.
groups.rationale: All five identify the same missing optional guard in EventManager. One edit resolves every report.
